gaps.explanation: The General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p8) prints Local receipts 1,148,950 (total receipts 6,573,632), while the combining General Fund statement (p5) prints the General Fund column Local 1,144,442 (total 6,569,124) and 'Sale of assets' 4,508 under other financing sources; the governmental funds statement (p4) likewise prints Sale of assets 4,508 under other financing, not in receipts (total receipts 10,676,226). 1,148,950 - 1,144,442 = 4,508: the budget schedule counts the sale of assets as Local receipts. Detail takes General Fund receipts from the budget schedule as printed, so detail is 4,508 above the statement (10,680,734 - 10,676,226 = 4,508). Both printed totals are correct on their own basis; no line is missing or duplicated.

The governmental funds statement (p4) General Fund column nets the transfers among the General Fund's sub-funds: Transfers in 0, out (1,164,370); Total Governmental Funds in 1,464,370 (Road 1,164,370 + Nonmajor 300,000). The combining General Fund statement (p5) prints them gross: Self-Health Insurance Fund transfers in 56,022 + Noxious Weed Fund 51,890 = 107,912, General transfers out (1,272,282). Detail records gross per fund: 56,022 + 51,890 + Road 1,164,370 (p10) + Road and Bridge 300,000 (p7) = 1,572,282 = 1,464,370 + 107,912. The gap is only the statement's netting of intra-General-Fund transfers.

Same netting as transfers_in: statement p4 Transfers - out (1,464,370) = General (1,164,370) + Road (300,000). Detail records General Fund transfers out (1,272,282) gross from the budget schedule p9 / combining statement p5 (includes 107,912 to the Self-Health Insurance and Noxious Weed sub-funds of the General Fund) + Road (300,000) (p10) = 1,572,282; 1,572,282 - 1,464,370 = 107,912, matched by the 107,912 sub-fund transfers in. No fix.
